item.title: Hochul scrambles to save health program insuring 1.7M people in NY
item.description: President Donald Trump and Congressional Republicans on July 4, 2025, at the celebration and bill signing for the president's massive domestic tax and spending plan, dubbed the "One Big Beautiful Bill." The measure cut taxes and gutted federal support for a swath of programs, including health insurance benefiting New Yorkers. Losing the Essential Plan after federal cuts would be a "freaking nightmare." [ more › ]
